title: Missing Person Report
summary: Take the report immediately; there is no waiting period.

steps.text: Accept the report immediately, no waiting period
Recent photo, physical description and clothing last worn
Phone number, carrier, social media accounts, vehicle and plate
Where last seen, with whom, and places the person might go
High risk: young child, elderly or impaired, medical need, suicide risk, or suspected abduction
High-risk cases: notify a supervisor right away and start an active search
Search the home and property where last seen, even if family already did
Enter persons under 21 into NCIC without delay (federal law: within two hours)
AMBER Alert requests go through NJ State Police when criteria are met
Canvass, check video, contact friends, school or work, and hospitals

note: Follow your department's policy and current AG directives. Not yet verified against official sources.
